title: Rain Rhyme
retell: Say the poem together. Clap on drip and drop!

pages.text:
Drip, drop, drip, drop,
the rain will never stop.

Puddles here and puddles there,
splash in puddles everywhere!

Pitter, patter, tap and tip,
rain is on my nose and lip.

Then the sun comes peeking out.
Rainbow time! Let us twirl and shout!

questions.q: What do you like to do on a rainy day?
